description: This file implements a DOM utility module '@drupal/once' that manages element initialization states by marking elements with a 'data-once' attribute to prevent multiple initializations. It provides functions to mark, unmark, filter, and find elements based on unique IDs, supporting usage as a module or script.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Helper to get or set the 'data-once' attribute on DOM elements.

methods.name: attrSelector
methods.description: Constructs a CSS selector string for a given 'once' ID.

methods.name: checkElement
methods.description: Verifies if an item is an instance of Element.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Processes various selector inputs to return an array of DOM elements.

methods.name: filterAndModify
methods.description: Filters elements by a selector and optionally applies a function to matched elements.

methods.name: updateAttribute
methods.description: Adds or removes a 'once' ID from an element's 'data-once' attribute.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Marks elements as processed with a specific ID, preventing re-initialization.
